data.turoyo: Aṯi u taʕlo lu tarʕo di mʕarṯo, omər: "Zoġo." Omər: "Ha." Omər: "Isaq l ḥaṣayye, fašay b ṭizayye, lašan d layḏi."
data.translation: Dann trat der Fuchs an die Oeffnung der Höle und rief: "Hahn!" "Ja!" "Steige auf ihren Rücken und tritt sie an ihrem Steisse, damit sie Eier legen."

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell: replaces no inherited text, but adds an independently cited command with explicit rooster context, posture and egg-laying purpose.

summary: Both records retain sense 1, rooster mating/treading. The affected body part is b-marked; the second verse explicitly connects the command to laying eggs.
PrS 73/67 is the existing Infectum example cited prs 212/8. Its additional fox clause does not justify a duplicate.
PrS 73/68 supplies full textual context for the previously isolated Imperativ fašáy. No new form box or lexical sense is needed.
